out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINKS ARE PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. OBSERVED PROBE THERMOMETER WAS NOT FUNCTIONAL AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC ORDERED BATTERIES FOR THERMOMETER DURING INSPECTION.
